hints.title: A block cannot close early
hints.body: A block cannot end before the last occurrence of every letter it contains.

hints.title: Record last positions
hints.body: Find the final index of each distinct letter before scanning.

hints.title: Expand the boundary
hints.body: As you scan, extend the current block end to the furthest last occurrence seen so far.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
last = map from letter to its final index
start = 0
end = 0
result = []
for i from 0 to length(text) - 1:
    end = max(end, last[text[i]])
    if i == end:
        append (end - start + 1) to result
        start = i + 1
return result
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
